segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for 38 seats and make sure the February 12 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that date still works. We have 31 users ready at launch, and then the other 7 are managers who’ll come in after training.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. So the subscription would start February 12 for all 38 seats, annual term, and the invoice would go out on signing. Total is $46,740 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the onboarding package we talked about, right? The two admin sessions and the end user webinar?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Two 60-minute admin sessions, one 45-minute end user webinar, and the setup checklist. No extra services line item beyond what’s already in the quote.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Procurement asked about payment terms. Can you do net 30, or is it due on receipt?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Net 30 is fine. I’ll make sure that’s reflected in the order form. The standard contract term is 12 months, February 12 through February 11 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. We also need the invoice to reference PO 78419. The PO should be approved by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. Once you send the PO over, I’ll attach it to the billing tool and issue the final order form for signature. Anything else procurement flagged?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that’s it. Send me the updated order form with net 30 and the seat count, and I’ll route it today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have it in the next hour, and I’ll hold the February 12 kickoff slot for your team.
